test_xformers_unbind: test xformers.ops.unbind to split a tensor along a given dimension and verify forward and backward pass correctness
test_xformers_stack_or_none: test xformers.ops.stack_or_none to re-stack unbound tensors along a specified dimension
test_xformers_get_stack_strides: test xformers.ops.get_stack_strides to retrieve the original stride of stacked tensors
test_xformers_unbind_contiguous: test xformers.ops.unbind with both contiguous and non-contiguous tensors across multiple dimensions
test_xformers_unbind_slicing: test xformers.ops.unbind and stack_or_none with various tensor slices including full, partial, and strided slices
